name: Hoichi
balanceNote: All attack damage uses buffed Physical ATK against Physical DEF. Screenshot-unspecified local tuning: Mystery 1.6 ATK total, standard 0.9, Senbon Barrage 1.25, standard Acupuncture chance 45%. Visual contacts split each move's total damage. Dharma Seal's explicit 8% current-HP effect (25000 per evasion) retains its own formula. The screenshot's evasion-based Chakra-cost reduction is used, rather than the alternate extracted XML's action-based wording. Barriers are skill effects, not autonomous summoned units.

mystery.name: Dharma Sealing Jutsu - Restraint
mystery.description: Causes unavoidable damage to up to 5 units in the opponent's lineup, causes Level 2 - Acupuncture until the end of the next round to the selected unit. If the selected unit is suffering from Acupuncture, additionally causes Dharma Seal to that unit. Cooldown 4; Battlefield Cooldown 0; Chakra Cost 20.

standard.name: Dharma Sealing Jutsu - Absorption
standard.description: Attacks a random line of opponent units, causes Suppress Immunity for 1 round and absorbs 20 Chakra from each unit hit, a chance of causing Level 2 - Acupuncture until the end of the round to a random unit hit.

pillars.name: Dharma Barrier - Celestial Pillars
pillars.description: If Hoichi's HP falls below 50%, grants Endurance to all units in your lineup and reduces his Mystery Cooldown to 0, can be triggered once per round. The first time this skill is activated in a battle, grants Perseverance instead, additionally dispels all Debuffs (including Level 2 Debuffs) he currently has and resets his action count. This skill is still active even when Hoichi is controlled.

barrage.name: Dharma Barrier - Senbon Barrage
barrage.description: Triggered at the end of the round Hoichi executes Dharma Sealing Jutsu - Restraint, causes unavoidable damage, 4 Combo to up to 9 units in the opponent's field and cancels all Buffs and Shields, causes Level 2 - Acupuncture until the end of the next round to the unit hit with the lowest HP.

inheritance.name: Bunpuku Inheritance
inheritance.description: Hoichi is immune to Debuffs and when he suffers damage, reduces his Mystery Cooldown by 1. While Hoichi is alive, your lineup's Secret Jutsu ninjas' damage neglects Shields and when they evade an action, reduces that unit's Mystery's Chakra Cost by 10 (stackable) until the end of the battle or until defeated. When Hoichi executes a Trigger skill, dispels all Acupuncture and Immobile he currently has.

statusDescriptions.acupuncture: Level 2 - Acupuncture: Units affected cannot execute Mystery. Lasts until the stated round ends.
statusDescriptions.seal: Dharma Seal: Whenever units affected execute a Trigger skill, suffer Level 2 - Acupuncture until the end of the round. At the end of the round, suffer damage equal to 8% of their current HP (max 25000) for every Evasion during the Debuff. Lasts until the end of the next round.
statusDescriptions.endurance: Endurance: 45% less damage, not stackable or dispellable. Lasts until the end of the next round or until the affected unit executes a Mystery.
statusDescriptions.perseverance: Perseverance: Whenever units suffer damage, they only suffer 1 damage. Lasts until the end of the round. When gained, dispels Melt and Pollen Poison.
